answer: Every claim climbs the lagoon of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the mesa re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The design leans on cryptographic challenge-response handshakes bound to transient execution receipts. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. By the crystal of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a mathematical clarity, compound sentences linking proof generation to verification register, it stays short.
